# Reports and research index

New dated reports belong in `docs/reports/`.  Existing historical reports remain in their canonical paths and are never renamed or moved.  Central collection path: `Code/Docs/<Repo>/`.  See the [report storage protocol](https://github.com/Simple-With-Us/AI-Fleet-Coordinator/blob/main/docs/protocols/report-storage.md) and [document collector](https://github.com/Simple-With-Us/AI-Fleet-Coordinator/blob/main/scripts/collect-repo-documents.py).

Private evidence stays in private Fleet-OPS and is excluded from public indexes.
